description: Scrape Apple App Store apps and reviews. Search by keyword, look up by app ID, or paste App Store URLs directly.

appIds.description: Specific Apple App Store app IDs to look up (e.g., '544007664' for YouTube).
appIds.title: App IDs

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the App Store region (e.g., 'us', 'gb', 'de', 'jp'). Affects pricing, availability, and reviews language.
country.title: Country Code

includeReviews.description: Fetch customer reviews for each app. Up to 50 reviews per page, controlled by Review Pages setting.
includeReviews.title: Include Reviews

maxResults.description: Maximum number of apps to return per search term (up to 200).
maxResults.title: Max Results

reviewPages.description: Number of review pages to fetch per app (50 reviews per page, max 10 pages = 500 reviews). Only used when Include Reviews is enabled.
reviewPages.title: Review Pages per App

searchTerms.description: List of keywords to search for on the App Store. Each term will return matching apps.
searchTerms.sectionDescription: Provide search terms, app IDs, or App Store URLs.
searchTerms.title: Search Terms

startUrls.description: Direct App Store URLs (e.g., https://apps.apple.com/us/app/youtube/id544007664). The app ID is extracted automatically.
startUrls.title: App Store URLs

title: App Store Scraper Input
